assertions.description:
Checks that whenever rst_n=0, done is 0 in the same cycle (asynchronous reset).
Scans all cycles where rst_n is deasserted and verifies done=0.
assertions.name: reset_clears_done

assertions.description:
Checks that encryption begins automatically after 144 load bits without any extra trigger.
Verifies that done eventually asserts after a complete 144-bit load sequence,
and that no additional load_en pulse is needed between load completion and done.
assertions.name: encrypt_auto_starts

assertions.description:
Checks the PRESENT S-box mapping: 0->C,1->5,2->6,3->B,4->9,5->0,6->A,7->D,
8->3,9->E,A->F,B->8,C->4,D->7,E->1,F->2.
Verifies by simulating encryption and comparing ciphertext against observed dout bits.
assertions.name: sbox_mapping

assertions.description:
Checks the pLayer permutation P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62, P(63)=63.
Verifies by simulating encryption with correct pLayer and comparing against observed ciphertext.
assertions.name: player_permutation

assertions.description:
Checks that the key schedule performs a 61-bit left rotation of the 80-bit key_reg each round.
Verifies indirectly by simulating full encryption and comparing ciphertext.
assertions.name: key_schedule_rotate

assertions.description:
Checks that after 61-bit rotation, key_reg[79:76] is replaced by S(key_reg[79:76]).
Verifies indirectly by simulating full encryption and comparing ciphertext.
assertions.name: key_schedule_sbox

assertions.description:
Checks that the 5-bit round counter i (1..31) is XORed into key_reg[19:15] each round.
Verifies indirectly by simulating full encryption and comparing ciphertext.
assertions.name: key_schedule_round_counter_xor

assertions.description:
Checks that done transitions to 1 after the 32nd encrypt cycle and remains high
until reset or a new load begins.
assertions.name: done_asserted_after_encrypt

assertions.description:
Checks that while done=1 and shift_out_en=1, dout outputs ciphertext bits MSB-first.
Collects 64 dout bits and verifies they match the simulated ciphertext MSB-first.
assertions.name: unload_serial_msb_first

assertions.description:
Checks that dout is only required to be valid when done=1 and shift_out_en=1.
This assertion verifies the contract is not violated by checking that we do NOT
require dout to be any specific value when done=0 or shift_out_en=0.
Since the contract says dout may be any value in those cases, we simply verify
that the observed dout is always 0 or 1 (a valid binary signal).
assertions.name: dout_stable_when_not_unloading

assertions.description:
Checks that asserting load_en while done=1 clears done and begins a new load phase.
Scans for cycles where done=1 and load_en=1, then verifies done is cleared.
assertions.name: new_load_aborts_done

rationale_notes: These assertions operate on the serial interface of PRESENT-80.
Since we only observe 1-bit serial signals (din, dout, done, load_en, shift_out_en),
we must reconstruct internal state from the observable serial stream.
For sbox/player/key_schedule invariants we simulate the cipher internally and
compare against observed outputs (dout bits during unload phase).
The stim list contains input signals per cycle; observed contains output signals per cycle.
We treat each dict entry as the value sampled at that rising clock edge.
